retrieval_skill.name: forecast_window_event_triangulation
retrieval_skill.description: Identify temporary external drivers that overlap the forecast window, then connect them to the target series through mechanism evidence, direct behavioral observations, quantified magnitude, and explicit duration.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series that may be affected by scheduled or otherwise knowable events during the forecast horizon.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for events overlapping the forecast window using the target context and location, then separately seek sources describing the causal mechanism, target-specific observations, quantitative deviation from baseline, and event start and end boundaries.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept an impact claim only when sources establish temporal overlap and a plausible target linkage; treat magnitude and duration as usable only when explicitly reported, preserve exact-quote and provenance requirements, and do not extrapolate the adjustment beyond the supported window.
